subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my CPS note for {Brand}. Now that Google lets free product listings run straight through a CSS Merchant Center, the comparison tier you share with PriceRunner and Idealo has reshuffled, and the third-party CSS edge on Shopping clicks now sits around 16 to 18 percent of CPC. That shifts the margin question from clicks to confirmed sales, where a returns-window-validated referral pays for itself. We hold out a control group so the referrals show as incremental to your own organic shoppers. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: Google CSS free-listings integration (sourced) + 16-18% CSS CPC margin band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN comparison_aggregator: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior CPS note; fresh angle = timely Google CSS free-listings-via-Merchant-Center development + real CSS CPC margin band 16-18% (savvyrevenue, retrieved and confirmed); rotates to PriceRunner and Idealo from brand_candidates, no brand outside the set, no cross_border giant as local rival; MobUpps incrementality holdout referenced with no figure; exactly 1 question mark; British-English register; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X-not-Y.
